primary_population: Eligible ICU stays alive and still under ICU observation at the 24-hour landmark, with at least one valid typed lactate measurement during the complete ICU 0-24-hour window.
primary_estimand: Among ICU stays alive and still under ICU observation at 24 hours, the adjusted descriptive association between complete 0-24-hour peak lactate and post-landmark in-hospital death; this is prognostic/descriptive, not causal.
secondary_descriptive_sensitivity: Retain the original variable-opportunity measured-subset association only as a secondary descriptive sensitivity, accompanied by early-death, early-discharge, observation-duration, and measurement-intensity audits.
reportability_rule: Report the primary 24-hour landmark association only when alive/under-observation status, complete 0-24-hour exposure opportunity, measurement state, units, timestamps, and post-landmark death are verified. Report the variable-opportunity analysis only as a labelled secondary descriptive sensitivity with full-cohort measurement and exposure-opportunity audits.
